name: dsh-project-hub-ui
description: Web client bundle: the Project Hub board for project-pipeline. Sidebar footer action entry opens a full-screen overlay listing all projects (state/iteration/current stage/pending gate/budget), with per-project detail drill-down, plus a scan-root config card in Settings - Plugins - Plugin configuration. Settings tab (kr-control-plane-i2): two-module redo (sedimentation policy + per-role model) with partition nav, model dropdown from dsh configured models (view=models), and C-D read-modify-write guard.
